title: Run E13 schedule checks without a database
public_pr_body:
Add `npm run test:timesheet-schedule`: 84 real scheduling/form tests with no database, Supabase client, mail credentials or Docker. Include explicit impossible seconds (08:00:99/60), all ISO weekdays, empty days, off-by-default behavior and both UK daylight-saving boundaries.

Keep the existing #192 tests and source behavior intact. Document the checks that genuinely require a database in tests/TIMESHEET-OFFLINE.md: RLS/persistence, migration 142, concurrent claims/idempotency, ledger writes and live cron/browser delivery.

Base: codex2/e13-more-tests (#192). Validation: all 84 offline tests passed; typecheck and targeted ESLint passed. Live database/provider checks were not run and no SQL applied.
